provenance.labelled_by: coding agent: seeded paint trace (scripts/label_lane_marks.py) plus visual check of the drawn overlay
provenance.method: a seed row is scanned for paint runs of the right colour, the trace walks up and down from there, a quadratic is fitted and every surviving point is drawn back onto the frame. The lane model is never loaded by the labeller.
provenance.coordinate_system: original frame pixels (x, y), origin top-left; x is the centre of the paint run
provenance.clips: test_data/lane_clips: C = Conor Pass (CC BY-SA 4.0), D = Ljubljana to Kranj (CC BY 3.0)
provenance.why_few_frames: 10 frames were extracted and traced, 13 in total including four extra C frames; only the 8 below survived the overlay check. Traces that followed a guardrail, a road sign, a lamp post or the chevron hatching were discarded, and frame C01 was dropped because its trace covered only 12 rows.
provenance.limitations: 8 frames from 2 clips, one wet daylight mountain road and one dusk motorway. No night, no rain, no construction. The C clip contributes one boundary per frame, so ego-pair checks there must fail by construction and are reported separately.
